note.question: What role does distribution-free inventory risk pooling play in a multilocation newsvendor?
note.overview: This paper studies a multilocation newsvendor network when the only information available on the joint distribution of demands are the values of its mean vector and covariance matrix. We adopt a distributionally robust model to find inventory levels that minimize the worst-case expected cost among the distributions consistent with this information. The paper finds a closed-form tight bound on the expected cost when there are only two locations.
